title: Private Deployments Weekly — Standup Notes 2026-04-20
content:
Date: 2026-04-20
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Marco Chen, Sofia Martinez, Liam O'Connor, Priya Rao, Errin (support), customer-ops liaisons (as needed)
Duration: 30m

Summary: Weekly sync focused on active VPC/on-prem installs and current customer blockers. Primary themes this week: networking/firewall rules blocking outbound to model registry, KMS integration for on-prem installs, and a kernel/GPU driver mismatch discovered during validation on Customer A cluster.

Standup updates (by owner):
- Aisha: Coordinating on Customer A (Acme Health) install. Validation run failed during model sync stage due to TLS handshake failures against model-registry.redwood.internal. Worked with infra to reproduce. Raised PD-3421.
  - Blocker: Customer network team currently blocking egress to our model registry CIDR. Customer is unwilling to open wide egress; need guidance on proxy or private peering options.
  - Action: Drafted a short options memo (p2) with tradeoffs (S3 proxy, private peering, customer-hosted mirror). Owner: Aisha. ETA: 2026-04-23.

- Marco: Completed the latest installer PR that adds optional KMS integration for on-prem keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/pull/467.
  - Tested on lab cluster with HashiCorp Vault and AWS KMS shim. One regression found: helm chart values schema mismatch caused values.yaml validation errors for existing customers.
  - Action: Patch incoming to fix schema. Owner: Marco. ETA: 1 day.

- Sofia: Investigating BrightBank (Customer B) GPU bootstrap failures. The node images shipped with NVIDIA driver 530.x but our runtime validated against 535.x giving cuBLAS symbol errors during inference smoke tests.
  - Blocker: Customer can't upgrade drivers immediately due to infra freeze.
  - Mitigation: Proposal to publish a compatible runtime build pinned to 530.x for these customers (short-term). Longer-term: recommend standard driver baseline in onboarding docs.
  - Action: Create RINF-1024 runtime build ticket and plan rollout. Owner: Sofia. ETA: 2026-04-24.

- Liam: Rollout telemetry: added additional logging for: install step durations, helm release failures, and post-install health checks. This helped narrow down where Customer A's install fails (step: model-sync).
  - Action: Add a short snippet to the runbook showing how to interpret the new telemetry. Owner: Liam. ETA: 2026-04-22.

- Priya (SRE/customer-ops): On-call handled two support escalations overnight. Both were networking-related (DNS timeouts from on-prem cluster to our auth endpoint). Worked with support to get temporary firewall holes opened. Suggested longer-term: include a preflight DNS+egress check in installer.
  - Action: Create preflight check ticket PD-3419. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-04-27.

Customer-specific notes:
- Customer A (Acme Health) — PD-3421
  - Symptoms: TLS handshake failures during model-sync; installer retries then times out.
  - Root cause hypothesis: egress blocked to model registry CIDR or TLS MITM by corporate proxy.
  - Next steps: (1) Validate via tcpdump with customer (Aisha to schedule 1h debug session 2026-04-21), (2) propose three options memo (S3 proxy, mirror, private peering) by 2026-04-23.
  - Impact: Blocked for go-live; customer decision required.

- Customer B (BrightBank) — runtime driver mismatch
  - Symptoms: inference runtime fails with cuBLAS symbol errors during smoke tests.
  - Short-term: provide pinned runtime matching 530.x. Long-term: update onboarding doc and validator to check driver versions before install.

Open blockers and risks:
- Network egress policies: recurring theme across multiple installs. We need a standard supported pattern (private peering vs customer proxy). Decision required from product regarding which patterns we will fully support and document.
- KMS/HSM integrations: customers expect bring-your-own KMS; OSS shim works but we need a validated, hardened flow for enterprise customers. Current PR adds config but lacks full test matrix with Vault/GCP/KMS/HSM.
- Driver compatibility surface: we do not have exhaustive tested matrices across popular enterprise GPU images. Risk of frequent short-term patches unless we standardize minimal driver baseline.

Decisions made this week:
- Ship a hotfix to the installer to correct the helm values schema (Marco). Patch will be backward compatible.
- Accept short-term runtime pinning for BrightBank while we update onboarding docs and validator.
- Add preflight DNS+egress check to installer; prioritize PD-3419.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Aisha: Schedule tcpdump debug with Customer A and customer network team. ETA 2026-04-21.
- Aisha: Write options memo (S3 proxy vs mirror vs peering). ETA 2026-04-23.
- Marco: Merge helm values schema patch and cut new installer release. ETA 2026-04-21.
- Marco: Coordinate with QA for regression tests on KMS config. ETA 2026-04-28.
- Sofia: Create runtime build ticket RINF-1024 and start pinned build for driver 530.x. ETA 2026-04-24.
- Liam: Add telemetry snippet to runbook. ETA 2026-04-22.
- Priya: Create preflight check ticket PD-3419 and draft spec. ETA 2026-04-27.

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider offering a managed mirror appliance that can be deployed in customer VPC to avoid egress requirements and speed syncs for large-model installs. Scope: small VM + rsync + signed model artifacts.
- Investigate peering/private interconnect options with major cloud providers as product offering for Dedicated/Private customers.

Misc references / links:
- On-Prem install runbook (work in progress): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PD/pages/1234567/On-Prem+Install+Runbook
- Installer PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/pull/467
- JIRA: PD-3421, PD-3419, RINF-1024

Next sync: 2026-04-27 weekly standup.

Unresolved questions:
- Product: do we accept mirrors as supported pattern or only peering/proxy? Need product/GTMs call by 2026-04-24.
- Security: can we provide a vetted, audited container image for customers who can't upgrade drivers? SRE and security to evaluate risk.

End of notes.
